image_prompt: A single photographic image captures a woman in a bright yellow raincoat standing on a wet, stone-paved cliff path overlooking turbulent ocean waves crashing against rocks. Behind her, a white lighthouse with a red lantern room and railing stands defiantly atop a rugged coastline under a heavy, stormy sky. Her dark hair is tousled by wind, and she gazes forward with a solemn expression, positioned slightly right-of-center in the frame. The lighting is dim yet directional, casting subtle highlights on the slick surface of the path and the spray of breaking waves, while atmospheric haze softens distant elements. No text or collaged overlays exist within the image.
idea_input: The woman slowly turns her gaze toward the sea. Wind gently moves her hair and yellow coat. Keep the camera fixed, with waves and wind only; no music, no speech, no cuts.
